propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 declare identical 1M context windows in MODEL_LADDER, so escalation from sonnet to opus gains zero additional capacity.
A context-limit retry that escalates sonnet→opus will fail again at the same limit but at higher pricing, with no diagnostic signal that the rungs are identical.
The fix is to filter escalation_rungs() to skip any rung whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, leaving models_at_or_above() and MODEL_LADDER unchanged.
Both context-limit retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to avoid no-op paid calls.
Structural guards ensure MODEL_LADDER windows are non-decreasing and escalation_rungs' returned sequences are strictly increasing from every start rung.
Window figures are verified correct against the provider's live Models API (max_input_tokens), so the defect is in consumption, not in the declared numbers.
